item.title: 【環境】 Mapping hunting probability across the tropics in space and time
item.description: Hunting wildlife for food and trade purposes (for example, pets, ornaments) can contribute to species extinctions, warranting informed policy and interventions to curb overexploitation. Towards such goals, the authors here estimate the spatial footprint of hunting probability across the global tropics.

item.title: 【自動自律実験】 Will you be wearing an exoskeleton in ten years? The tech that could change how we move
item.description: Robotic supports were once designed for clinical use, but researchers are now developing cheaper, smaller devices aimed at everyone — from people with ageing knees to 20-somethings seeking to climb mountains.
